lead: Manmeet Bhullar was a Canadian politician, born on 1 March 1980 in Calgary.
He died on 23 November 2015 in Red Deer County at the age of 35.
He has held the office of member of Alberta Legislative Assembly and member of Alberta Legislative Assembly.
The sections that follow break down Manmeet Bhullar's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Manmeet Bhullar — Career and Professional Work
paras: Manmeet Bhullar works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: member of Alberta Legislative Assembly, member of Alberta Legislative Assembly (2008–2012), member of Alberta Legislative Assembly (2012–2015) and member of Alberta Legislative Assembly (2015–2015). He is affiliated with Progressive Conservative Association of Alberta.
